quantity: Approximate collective DHFR throughput, eight concurrent MPS processes, tuned thread percentage, single H100 or L40S (microseconds/day)

source.citation: Darren Hsu, David Clark and Janet Paulsen, Maximizing OpenMM Molecular Dynamics Throughput with NVIDIA Multi-Process Service, NVIDIA Technical Blog, 2025-06-04

reason: Article reports throughput approaching this value, without acceptance criterion or uncertainty. Approximate fixed-time observation, not a fixed-work energy or timing target.
configuration: OpenMM 8.2.0 benchmark.py --platform=CUDA --test=pme --seconds=60; eight processes; CUDA_MPS_ACTIVE_THREAD_PERCENTAGE=200/8=25. No claim that this value applies to deterministic fixed-work driver.
